adjudication.rationale: In Office365CalendarService, the refresh flow now calls `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)` and then merges `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`. When `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` is set, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` uses `minimumTokenResponseSchema`, which (as a Zod object) strips unknown fields and does not explicitly include Office365 expiry fields like `expires_in`/`expiry_date`. That means the merged credential can retain the previous (stale) expiry values rather than updating them from the refresh response, which can plausibly cause the credential to be considered expired repeatedly and trigger refresh on every use.
